fields.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Zeri''' generates 1 charge for every 40 units she travels by any means and 10 charge every time she casts ''{{ai|Burst Fire|Zeri}}'', up to a maximum of 100 charge. Her {{tip|basic attacks}} consume charge to deal '''modified''' damage.
'''Zeri''' gains maximum charge when the game starts and upon [[respawn]]ing.
fields.description2: {{tip|Basic Attack|{{sbc|Basic Attack:}}}} '''Zeri''' zaps the target, dealing {{as|{{pp|10+(15/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 3% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}}, applying {{tip|spell effects}} as {{tip|spell damage}}, triggering on-cast effects and {{ccs|executing|magic}} the target if they are below {{pp|70 + (160-70)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=hp}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} {{sti|{{as|health}}}}. This cannot {{tip|critically strike}} and does not apply nor trigger {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects.
fields.description3: At full charge, '''Zeri's''' next attack is empowered to consume all charge to deal {{as|{{pp|75 + (160-75)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 110% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{pp|1 + (11-1)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|magic damage}}. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 300 against {{tip|monsters}}.
fields.notes:
* Charged attacks only deal the '''base''' damage to {{tip|structures}}.
* Uncharged attacks do not execute enemies that are {{tip|shield|shielded}} or {{tip|invulnerable}} while below the health threshold.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block a fully charged attack. Uncharged attacks are not blocked.
* The attack's range '''is''' affected by attack range modifiers ({{ii|Rapid Firecannon}}) (tested on patch 26.12).
* Uncharged and charged attacks trigger {{iis|Tear of the Goddess}} {{nie|Mana Charge}}.
* Attacking a turret does not consume [[Crystalline Overgrowth]].
* The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed against {{tip|wards}} or [[jungle plants]].
* If [[Minion#Last_Hit_Indicator|Last Hit Indicator]] enabled, it will indicate ''Living Battery's'' {{tip|execute}} threshold instead of its usual function.

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
